# Byte vectors of the co-op wire format, protocol 3. Written by `tests/coop_proto_test.c --write-vectors`,
# read back by it through tests/test_coop_proto.py: the codec is pinned to these bytes, so a change that
# moves one shows as a failure here. Hex is lower case, "-" is empty. Fields are tokens; a name, an area and
# a message are hex of their bytes; a POS's four numbers are hex of their IEEE-754 bits.
#
# frame <name> <type> <src> <dst> <kind> <payload> <frame>              parse, check the header, pack again
# hello <name> <proto> <session> <name> <payload>                        a joiner's HELLO
# welcome <name> <member> <proto> <room id> <roster members> <payload>  the host's answer
# roster <name> <members> <payload>                                      the host's list of the room
# error <name> <reason> <text> <payload>                                 why a join was refused
# kick <name> <member> <session> <payload>                               the host removed one
# u32 <name> <value> <payload>                                           a PING or PONG token
# msg <name> <session> <counter> <kind> <message> <payload>              a player message in its envelope
# event <name> <kind> <recipient session> <id> <total> <part> <bytes> <payload>
# eventack <name> <sender session> <id> <parts> <epoch> <payload>         parts received, of this epoch
# sign <name> <seed> <message> <public key> <signature>                   the key a seed gives, and what it signs
# roomid <name> <16 bytes> <text>                                         the room as the log shows it
# nameclean <name> <bytes> <cleaned>                                      a name from untrusted bytes
# reject <parser> <name> <bytes>                                          the parser must refuse these
